about.title: About
about.lead: These days the hours go into AI applications.
about.leadSub: How agents finish real work, and how interfaces talk.
about.p1: Most of it is business-facing agents: how context gets handed over, how tools get wired in, how a run pulls itself back onto the rails. That whole job outside the model has a name — harness — and it takes up most of my time. Retrieval too, from chunking and recall to an answer that can actually ship.
about.p2: This site is the motion lab I keep on the side: GSAP, Rive, Lottie, whatever the mood asks for. Even the blink and the steam off the cup are running real animation.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p: Taking projects, and open to the right role: agent applications, interfaces and motion, or something that has to go from nothing to a working demo — tell me the scope before either of us does the math. I check my inbox twice a day, patient the way this page is drawn: hands in pockets, ready to wait.
